open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings port validation
open_points.text: A8: a required setting is present, an optional one that is absent takes its decided default, and every value has the form its row of the start-up table declares.
open_points.question: Must PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT values outside 1 through 65535 end the start, even though they have the row's declared int form?
options: End the start for any port outside 1 through 65535, as A8 requires.
Accept every parseable integer because State 5 requires only the form declared by the row.
open_points.default_guess: End the start for any port outside 1 through 65535.

witness.initial: All required settings are valid and PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is set to 0.
events: module:runtime_settings calls load_runtime_settings and reads the environment.
outcomes: The operation ends the start because A8 permits ports only from 1 through 65535.
The operation returns run settings with port 0 because 0 has the declared int form.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service starts.

open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings timezone validation
open_points.text: A missing required setting or a value of the wrong form ends the start.
open_points.question: Must a syntactically valid string that is not known by the time zone database end the start, as A8 requires?
options: End the start when the time zone database does not know the value.
Accept any string because the start-up row declares timezone as str and the value is not of the wrong form.
open_points.default_guess: End the start when the time zone database does not know the value.

witness.initial: All required settings are valid and PORTAL_DELIVERER_TIMEZONE is set to Mars/Olympus, which the time zone database does not know.
events: module:runtime_settings calls load_runtime_settings and reads the environment.
outcomes: The operation ends the start under A8's time-zone validity rule.
The operation returns run settings containing Mars/Olympus because it is a string of the row's declared form.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service starts.

open_points.subject: public_op:runtime_settings.load_runtime_settings port decoding
open_points.text: every value has the form its row of the start-up table declares
open_points.question: What exact environment-string grammar is accepted as the int value of PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT, including signs, leading zeroes and surrounding whitespace?
options: Accept any environment string the chosen integer parser accepts, subject to the 1–65535 range.
Accept only unsigned ASCII decimal digits with no whitespace or sign, subject to the 1–65535 range.
open_points.default_guess: Accept only unsigned ASCII decimal digits with no whitespace or sign, then require a value from 1 through 65535.

witness.initial: All required settings are valid and PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is set to " 8850 ".
events: module:runtime_settings calls load_runtime_settings and reads the environment.
outcomes: The operation trims or otherwise accepts the string and returns port 8850.
The operation treats the string as having the wrong form and ends the start.
witness.observer: The deployment operator sees whether the service starts.
